Why this matters for SSC

"Which committee/commission gave which report?" — 1–2 marks per paper. Below covers the most-frequently-asked.

---

Key concepts

  • Centre-State relations: Sarkaria (1983), Punchhi (2007–10).
  • Panchayati Raj: Balwant Rai Mehta, Ashok Mehta, Singhvi, G.V.K. Rao, Yugandhar.
  • Poverty: Lakdawala → Tendulkar → Rangarajan.
  • Education: Kothari Commission, NEP 2020 (Kasturirangan).
  • Banking: Narasimham I (1991), Narasimham II (1998).
  • Constitution: B.R. Ambedkar (Drafting Committee); V.N. Pattabhi Sitaramayya (President of Constituent Assembly); Rajendra Prasad (later President of India).
